description: Source code for a GRE tunnel health check binary, including DHCP packet handling, IPv6 SLAAC monitoring, and interface management for Hotspot GRE tunnels.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating DHCP discovery, IPv6 SLAAC check, and interface setup/teardown.

methods.name: drop_root_privilege
methods.description: Drops root privileges for security.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions.

methods.name: create_testinterfaces
methods.description: Creates network interfaces and VLANs for testing.

methods.name: delete_testinterfaces
methods.description: Removes test network interfaces and VLANs.

methods.name: parse_if_inet6
methods.description: Checks if the specified interface has a global IPv6 address assigned.

methods.name: checkglobalipv6
methods.description: Thread function to monitor IPv6 SLAAC address assignment.

methods.name: timestamputc
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string.

methods.name: get_hardware_address
methods.description: Retrieves hardware (MAC) address and interface index.

methods.name: create_dhcp_socket
methods.description: Creates a socket for DHCP communication.

methods.name: create_raw_socket
methods.description: Creates a raw socket for packet injection.

methods.name: close_dhcp_socket
methods.description: Closes DHCP socket.

methods.name: send_dhcp_packet
methods.description: Sends a DHCP packet.

methods.name: send_dhcp_discover
methods.description: Constructs and sends DHCP DISCOVER.

methods.name: send_dhcp_request
methods.description: Constructs and sends DHCP REQUEST.

methods.name: send_dhcp_release
methods.description: Constructs and sends DHCP RELEASE.

methods.name: get_dhcp_offer
methods.description: Receives DHCP OFFER or ACK packets.

methods.name: receive_dhcp_packet
methods.description: Receives DHCP packets with timeout.

methods.name: dhcp_msg_type
methods.description: Extracts DHCP message type from packet options.

methods.name: get_dhcp_server_identifier
methods.description: Extracts DHCP server identifier from packet options.
